content: Popularity-based approaches. We recommend the most frequently used tags in the dataset, which is a common strategy for tag recommendations BIBREF9 . That is, a most popular INLINEFORM0 approach for editor tags and a most popular INLINEFORM1 approach for Amazon search terms. For e-books, for which we also have author (= INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 ) or BISAC (= INLINEFORM4 and INLINEFORM5 ) information, we use these features to further filter the recommended tags, i.e., to only recommend tags that were used to annotate e-books of a specific author or a specific BISAC.
